notes: Chunk A: topics M1.S2.T2, M2.S3.T3, M2.S4.T4, M2.S5.T5 (17 worked examples + 6 question/answer pairs).
Worked-example policy: the one diagram shows the whole figure the steps use (given parts INK, parts added by the steps ANSWER); numeric answers (counts, areas) are never printed on it.
Solution diagrams of pairs are ANSWER-coloured additions on the question's layout where a question diagram exists (Q1); Q4's solution is a rearrangement of the same four pieces.
Several base figures are teaching figures AND the source of a worked example's own diagram: each such figure has one entry for the teaching use (concept image) and a NEW- entry for the item.
Base remark corrected: P02-construction-2 (only one of the four triangles of the dotted square lies inside the original square).
Book mistakes: none found in the figures of this chunk (all printed numbers re-computed). LP text issues are listed in notes_A.md only; no LP text is edited here.

items.question_text: A square has side 1 unit. Each side is doubled. How many times the area is the new square?
items.reason: Word problem with every number in the text (side 1 doubled to 2, areas 1 and 4); the working is the arithmetic 2 x 2 = 4. The book's picture of the doubled square cut into 4 copies is teaching image C3.IMG1 (never linked) and the question does not point to a figure.
